text: Austria here. I propose we both stay out of each other's way in 1901: I won't move on VEN or TRI-ADR areas against you, and I'd like your support to keep Russia and Turkey from pushing west. Let's coordinate on the Balkans: I'm eyeing SER and possibly GRE, and I'd appreciate you not disturbing TRI or VIE.

Austria to Russia: I have no interest in fighting you early. I'd prefer to see RUM and SER go to whoever is not me in the short term, but I'm open to a deal where you keep out of GAL and BUD and we both focus elsewhere. Thoughts?

England here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks the others in 1901 and we all grab the neutral centers (NWY, DEN, SWE, HOL, BEL, SPA, POR, TUN, GRE, SER, RUM) without fighting each other. Russia and Turkey, I suggest you split the Balkans; France and Italy, the western Mediterranean is yours. England will take Norway and the North Sea side. Happy to discuss specifics.

France here. I propose peace: no one attacks France in 1901 and I will not move into Germany or Italy's home centers. I am open to a deal to keep Spain and Belgium contested neutrally. Let's all aim for a stable draw-ish balance and avoid early wars with each other.

Germany here. I propose peace: no one attacks into neighbors' home centers in 1901. Germany will take neutral centers (HOL, DEN) and stay out of France and Austria's homes. Open to coordinating against Russia's expansion if they grow too big. Reply with your intentions.

Italy here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone in 1901. Italy will stay in the Mediterranean (NAP, ROM, VEN) and wants TUN and GRE/ALB eventually. Austria, let's agree I don't contest TRI/VIE/BUD if you leave VEN and APU alone. Open to anyone who wants a non-aggression pact against Russia's expansion.

Russia here. I'm defensive and want no early wars with neighbours. Turkey: I propose we both stay out of the Black Sea and Armenia this year; I won't move south. Austria/Germany: I'm happy to keep the centre quiet. Let's aim for a stable multi-way draw; the biggest threat is whoever grows fastest, so let's watch each other.

Turkey here. Proposal: no one attacks anyone in 1901 except to take unowned centers (BUL, GRE, RUM, SER, TUN, SPA, POR, NWY, SWE, DEN, BEL, HOL). Russia, let's keep our border quiet in the south; I will take BUL and SER-area neutrals, not your centers. Happy to hear other proposals.

Austria here. I agree to a peaceful 1901 with no attacks on home centers. I plan to take SER and RUM-area neutrals (SER, maybe RUM) and hold BUD, TRI, VIE. Italy: I will not move into VEN or APU; please don't enter TRI or VIE. Russia: I will not enter GAL or WAR this year if you keep out of BUD and GAL. Let's keep a quiet centre.

England: I agree to peace in 1901. My fleets will head into the North Sea and toward Norway (NWY) and Denmark/Holland area as neutrals; I won't enter any power's home centers. Suggest we all grab only unowned centers this year and reassess in autumn. Germany, I'd appreciate you leaving Holland and Denmark to whoever gets there first, and I'll do the same with Belgium-France coordination.

France agrees to peace in 1901. I will take SPA and BEL with my fleet and army, and I will not move into Italy, Germany or England home centers. Proposal: if anyone breaks the peace, the rest of us coordinate against the aggressor. Russia and Turkey, I'm watching the Balkans; no hostility from me. Germany, let's keep BEL/HOL split: I take BEL, you take HOL.

Germany agrees with the peaceful opening. I will move to take HOL and DEN in 1901 and not attack anyone's supply centers. Suggest everyone keep to unowned centers this year. Germany is open to a non-aggression pact with France and Russia; anyone who attacks my home centers will face a united response.

Italy: agreed, no attacks on home centers in 1901. I will take TUN and keep NAP/ROM/VEN secure. I'm happy to coordinate against whoever grows fastest, and I'd like Austria to keep TRI and VIE quiet toward VEN. France and Italy: I'm open to a western Mediterranean deal (TUN for me, Spain stays neutral). Let's all report our intentions each round.

Russia: agreed, no attacks on anyone in 1901. I'll take the neutral centres in the north and Balkans only as they come open (RUM/SWE/NWY area) and will not enter Austrian, Turkish or German homes. Austria: I'll keep out of GAL and BUD this year if you do the same toward WAR/UKR. Turkey: I won't move into ARM or BLA; please keep your fleets out of the Black Sea. Let's all hold this year and see who breaks first.

Turkey agrees: no attacks on home centers in 1901. I will take BUL, GRE and SER from the neutrals and keep my fleet out of the Black Sea. Russia: I will not enter Sevastopol, Moscow or Rumania's home area; please do the same for Ankara and Constantinople. Proposal for all: whoever attacks a home supply center first gets blocked by the others. Let's keep the 1901 neutrals split fairly.

Austria: confirming peace for 1901. I will move on SER (and RUM only if unclaimed) and hold BUD, TRI, VIE. I am not attacking any home centers. Turkey and Russia: SER is my target this spring, so please don't contest it. Italy: I will not move into VEN or APU; I ask you to keep TRI and VIE clear. Let's report moves honestly each autumn.

England: agreed, no attacks on anyone's home centers in 1901. I'm moving my fleets to the North Sea toward Norway (NWY), and my army in Liverpool stays home. Russia, if you take NWY or SWE, that's fine by me; I'll look at Holland/Belgium only if they're still open. Let's all report each round and make the autumn decisions together.

France: confirmed for 1901. I take SPA (A MAR-SPA, fleet BRE-MAO path) and BEL (F BRE-PIC route to BEL next). I will not enter any home center. Italy: I'm fine with you taking TUN; France will not contest it. Germany: HOL is yours, I stay out of it. Everyone who keeps to neutrals this year is a friend of mine.

Germany confirms: I take HOL and DEN this spring with fleet KIE and armies staying home-side. I will not enter any power's home supply center in 1901. France, you take BEL; I will not contest it. Let's all keep peace and reassess in autumn.

Italy: agreed, no attacks on home centers in 1901. I am taking TUN with my fleet and keeping NAP, ROM and VEN closed. Austria: please keep TRI and VIE away from VEN and APU and I will do the same. France: I will not enter Spain or Tunis if you stay out of ROM, VEN and APU. Let's all report our moves honestly each round.

Russia: confirming peace for 1901. My units stay on home soil and I will not move into any power's home centres. I'll take only unowned centres (SWE, NWY, RUM) as they open. Turkey and Austria: please keep your forces out of Sevastopol, Moscow, Warsaw and Galicia this year and we'll all have a quiet autumn.

Turkey: agreed, peace in 1901. My moves this spring: CON to BUL and SMY/ANK stay put, taking BUL as the only neutral. I will not enter Black Sea or any home center. If anyone moves on Turkish homes (ANK, CON, SMY) I will respond with the others. Let's report final moves each round.

Austria: confirmed. This spring I move A BUD-SER and hold TRI and VIE. I am not attacking any home center. Russia: I will not enter GAL or WAR this year; please leave SER and RUM to me if you are not moving there. Italy: TRI and VIE stay put, VEN and APU are yours to keep.

England: confirming peace for 1901. My fleets move to the North Sea and toward Norway; LON and LVP stay home. I will not enter any power's home centers. Let's report final moves next round and keep the autumn split fair.
Germany: confirming for 1901. Fleet KIE to HOL, army BER and MUN stay home-side. I will not enter any power's home center. Thanks all for the clear reports; let's make autumn decisions together.

Italy: confirmed peace in 1901. My plan: F NAP-ION and F ROM/VEN hold, so Italy takes no neutral this spring beyond TUN in the fall. Any power that moves into NAP, ROM or VEN will be met with a united response. Austria, please keep TRI/VIE out of VEN and APU. I'll report my final orders next round.

Russia: my spring is quiet. Holding Moscow, Warsaw, Sevastopol and Stockholm/Norway routes are open only to unowned-centre grabs. I'm moving Stp fleet toward the Gulf of Bothnia and Warsaw/Moscow armies stay put. Austria: I'll stay out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey: no Black Sea moves from me. Let's keep reporting honestly.

Austria final: A BUD-SER this spring, VIE and TRI hold. No attacks on any home centers. Russia: please keep out of GAL and BUD; I will keep out of WAR and UKR. Italy: I am not touching VEN or APU. Let's keep the autumn fair.

England: final round. My orders this spring: F EDI-NWG, F LON-NTH, A LVP holds, to reach Norway and the North Sea in the autumn. I will not enter any power's home center. Thanks all for the clear reports; let's keep the autumn split fair.
Germany: final confirmation for 1901. Fleet KIE to HOL, army BER and MUN hold home-side. No moves into any home center. Good luck all; let's keep autumn decisions fair and transparent.

Italy: final report for S1901. F NAP-ION, F ROM and A VEN hold their positions with no moves into any power's home center. I will take TUN in the autumn with my fleet if it stays open. Any power that enters NAP, ROM or VEN will meet a united response from the rest of us.

Russia: final round. My spring orders: STP fleet to BOT, armies in Moscow and Warsaw hold. I will not enter any home centre or Black Sea. Austria, Turkey and everyone: keep this peace and we can all report honestly each autumn.
Turkey: final report for 1901. CON to BUL, ANK and SMY hold. No moves into any home center. Thanks all for honest reports; let's keep the autumn split fair and only take unowned centers.

Austria here. Fall 1901: I hold SER now and will keep BUD, TRI, VIE defended. I am not planning attacks on any home center. Russia and Turkey: please keep RUM and BUL contests peaceful; I will not move into GAL or WAR. Italy: I will not enter VEN or APU. Let's report final orders next round.

England: Fall 1901. I plan to move F NWG-NWY to take the open neutral Norway, and F NTH and A LVP stay home. Everyone else: any move into England's home centers (EDI, LON, LVP) will be met with a united response. I'm open to a fair split of the remaining neutrals and I will report my orders each round.

France: I have taken Spain (SPA). I plan F PIC-BEL this Fall to take Belgium, which is unowned. Germany: I see your fleet in HOL; I will not attack it. England: I'm not moving toward your home. Let's keep the peace and report Fall orders honestly.

Germany: I took HOL in spring. Autumn: I will hold my home centers and not enter any power's home center. Russia and Austria: please confirm you keep to the neutral centers (SER, RUM, SWE, NWY, DEN, BEL, TUN, GRE, BUL, SPA, POR) this autumn. Watch for any move into BER, KIE or MUN and expect a united response.

Italy: F ION is now adjacent to Tunis and the Balkans. My fall plan: F ION-TUN to take the neutral Tunis center, with A ROM and A VEN holding. Austria: you have moved into SER, which is fine, but I expect you to keep TRI and VIE clear of VEN. France: I'm not contesting Spain or Tunis movements beyond my own. Let's keep reporting moves honestly.

Russia: Autumn 1901 round 1. I'm taking SWE with fleet BOT and keeping Moscow, Warsaw and Sevastopol garrisoned. Austria: you moved to SER, which is fine. Turkey: BUL is now taken by you, so I'll stay out of RUM unless it stays unowned; I'd like to hear your plan. Let's keep all centre grabs to neutrals this autumn.

Turkey: Fall 1901. Austria took SER, Russia moved STP to BOT, Italy and France took neutrals. I have BUL. Proposal: no one attacks home centers in 1902; neutrals still open are GRE, RUM, BEL, HOL, DEN, NWY, SWE, POR, TUN, SPA. Turkey will take GRE next spring unless someone else has it. Russia: keep the Black Sea quiet and I'll keep ANK/CON/SMY home.

Austria: Fall 1901 plan: I am holding SER with A SER and keeping TRI, VIE, BUD defended. No moves into any home center. Russia: I will not touch RUM this autumn if you don't; I'd prefer RUM stays neutral between us. Turkey: GRE is open; I may contest it next spring, so let's talk before either of us moves there. Italy: I am keeping clear of VEN and APU.

England: Fall 1901 round 2. I will move F NWG-NWY to take neutral Norway. Russia: I see you moving toward SWE and NWY; please tell me if you are contesting NWY, since my fleet is headed there now. Everyone else: England keeps LON, EDI and LVP home and will respond to any move into them.

Germany: Fall 1901 round 2. I hold BER, KIE, MUN and HOL (neutral taken in spring). I will not enter any power's home center. Russia: SWE is open, fine by me. France and Italy: I'm happy with your neutral grabs. Anyone attacking BER, KIE or MUN meets a united response. Please keep reporting orders honestly.

Italy: round 2 for F1901. My orders stay as announced: F ION-TUN to take neutral Tunis; A ROM and A VEN hold. I will not enter any power's home center. Austria, please keep TRI and VIE away from VEN and APU and we're fine. Everyone: let's keep to neutral centers this autumn.

Russia: Fall 1901 round 2. Confirming: F BOT to SWE this autumn; A MOS, A WAR, F SEV hold. I will not enter any home centre or Black Sea. Austria and Turkey: RUM is open; I'd like to know who plans to take it so we avoid a bounce. Germany: I see your HOL move as fine.

Turkey: Fall 1901 plan. I hold BUL and will move ANK/CON/SMY to keep homes safe; I intend to take GRE in Fall 1902 via BUL-GRE if unclaimed. Russia: I will not enter RUM this autumn; you may take RUM if you want it, I will not contest. Austria: please keep SER and BUL as a clean border. Everyone: no attacks on home centers, and I'll report orders each round.

Austria: round 3 Fall 1901. My plan: A SER holds, TRI/VIE/BUD hold. I am not contesting RUM or GRE this autumn. Russia: if you take RUM, I won't contest it. Turkey: I'll respect BUL and SER as a clean border. Italy: I will not enter VEN or APU. Happy to hear anyone's objections before final orders.

England: Fall 1901 round 3. Confirming F NWG-NWY for neutral Norway this autumn; LON, EDI and LVP hold. Russia: since you are taking SWE, I'll take NWY and we avoid a bounce. Everyone: any move into EDI, LON or LVP gets a united response. Let's all keep to neutrals.

Germany: round 3 Fall 1901. My orders: armies and fleet hold at BER, MUN, HOL. No moves into any home center. Russia, SWE and NWY are open for you and England respectively; I won't contest. Let's keep autumn peaceful and report honestly.

Italy: round 3 for F1901. Unchanged: F ION-TUN for neutral Tunis; A ROM and A VEN hold. No moves into any home center. Austria: please keep TRI and VIE clear of VEN and APU. Let's all keep to neutrals this autumn.

Russia: round 3 for F1901. Final: F BOT-SWE, A MOS and A WAR hold, F SEV hold. England: SWE is my target, NWY is yours, no conflict. Turkey: thanks for not contesting RUM; I may take it in Fall 1902 if it stays open. Austria: keep SER clean. No home-centre moves from me.

Turkey: Fall 1901 round 3. Orders: A BUL holds, F ANK holds, A SMY holds. No moves into any home center. Spring 1902 I plan BUL-GRE if GRE is still neutral. Russia: I won't contest RUM this autumn; Austria, please tell us if you aim for RUM so we avoid a bounce.

Austria round 4 Fall 1901: I am holding SER with A SER and keeping BUD, TRI, VIE home units in place. I am not contesting RUM or GRE this autumn, and I won't enter any home center. Turkey: BUL and SER stay as a clean border. Italy: VEN and APU are safe from me. Final orders next round.
England: Fall 1901 round 4. Final orders: F NWG-NWY to take neutral Norway; F NTH and A LVP hold. No moves into any home center. Russia: NWY is mine, SWE is yours, no conflict.
Italy: round 4 for F1901. Final: F ION-TUN for neutral Tunis; A ROM and A VEN hold. No moves into any home center. Austria, please keep TRI and VIE clear of VEN and APU.

Russia: round 4 for F1901. Final orders unchanged: F BOT-SWE, A MOS, A WAR and F SEV hold. I will not enter any home centre or the Black Sea. Austria and Turkey: if either of you moves on RUM this autumn, tell us now so we avoid a bounce.

Austria final round Fall 1901: A SER holds, VIE, TRI, BUD hold. I am not moving on RUM or GRE this autumn and will not enter any home center. Russia: RUM is not my target this year. Turkey: BUL and SER remain a clean border. Italy: VEN and APU are safe from me.
England: Fall 1901 final round. Orders: F NWG-NWY for neutral Norway; F NTH and A LVP hold. No moves into any home center. Russia: NWY is mine, SWE is yours, no conflict.
Italy: final round for F1901. F ION-TUN for neutral Tunis; A ROM and A VEN hold. No moves into any home center. Austria, keep TRI and VIE clear of VEN and APU. Thanks all for honest reports.
Russia: final round for F1901. My orders: F BOT-SWE, A MOS, A WAR and F SEV hold. No home-centre or Black Sea moves from me. Let's keep the autumn clean and report honestly next year.
Turkey final for F1901: A BUL, F ANK and A SMY hold. No moves into any home center. Spring 1902 I plan BUL-GRE if GRE stays neutral; I am not moving on RUM this autumn.

Austria Winter 1901: I will build A in BUD to defend the Balkans and keep the peace. No moves on any home center from me. Open to discussing DEN, GRE, RUM and POR as neutrals for 1902; I would like to avoid any fight with Russia or Turkey over RUM.

England: Winter 1901. I now hold EDI, LON, LVP and NWY, 4 centers. I plan to build a fleet at LON for the North Sea and keep my home defended. Everyone: no attacks on home centers in 1902; let's agree on the remaining neutrals (DEN, GRE, POR, RUM) and split them fairly. I'm open to a DEN deal with Germany or Russia.
Germany: Winter 1901. I will build at KIE (army) for defense. No attacks planned from me. Reminder: the neutral centers left are DEN, GRE, POR, RUM. Let's keep 1902 peaceful and grab only neutrals.

Italy: Winter 1901. I hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN. I will build one unit at NAP for defense. Neutrals left: DEN, GRE, POR, RUM. France and Russia lead on 5; let's keep the balance and avoid any bounce into home centers. Italy will not attack anyone's home centers.

Russia: I now hold 5 centres and will build one unit at STP for 1902 defence. Austria, Turkey, Germany: we all still have open neutrals (RUM, GRE, POR, DEN). Let's keep 1902 peaceful and grab only unowned centres, starting with RUM and DEN.

England: Winter 1901 round 2. I'll build a fleet at LON as planned for the North Sea. I agree neutrals DEN, GRE, POR, RUM should go to whoever takes them without bounces; I'd like to know who plans DEN so we avoid a clash. No attacks on home centers from me.

Germany: Winter 1901 round 2. I am building A at KIE (already ordered). Germany will not attack any home center. I'm open to DEN for Germany via KIE in 1902 if no one else claims it; England and Russia, please tell me your plans for DEN so we avoid a bounce.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 2. I'm building F at STP/SC as announced. Neutrals left: RUM, DEN, GRE, POR. I will take RUM in Fall 1902 if it stays unowned and nobody else moves there; Austria and Turkey, please confirm you are not moving on RUM this spring. I will not enter any home centre.

Turkey Winter 1901: I hold ANK, CON, SMY, BUL (4). I will build one army at CON for defense. Neutrals left: GRE, RUM, DEN, POR. Turkey plans BUL-GRE in Spring 1902 and will not move on RUM or any home center. Russia, Austria: no attacks on home centers in 1902; let's keep it clean.

Austria Winter 1901 round 3: I am building A at BUD (already ordered). I am not moving on RUM this spring; Russia, RUM is yours to take if unbounced. I'll hold SER, TRI, VIE, BUD and attack no home centers. Turkey: BUL-GRE is fine by me, I'm not contesting GRE. Let's keep 1902 clean.

England: Winter 1901 round 3. I'm building F at LON for the North Sea. I have no claim on DEN, RUM, GRE or POR and will not contest them. Germany, DEN is yours if you move via KIE; I'll stay out. No attacks on home centers from England.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 3. I'm building F at STP/SC. I plan to take RUM in Fall 1902 and DEN is open for whoever moves first; I'm not contesting DEN with Germany or England this spring. Austria and Turkey, please say now if you intend RUM in 1902 so we avoid a bounce.

Turkey Winter 1901 round 3: I confirm I am not moving on RUM in Spring 1902. My plan is BUL-GRE in Spring 1902 and I will build A at CON. Russia, I will not contest RUM; Austria, please confirm you will not contest RUM either. Let's keep home centers clean.

Austria Winter 1901 round 4: Confirmed, I am not contesting RUM in 1902. Russia, RUM is yours if unbounced. I'm building A at BUD only and holding SER, TRI, VIE. No home-center attacks from me. Happy to keep the peace through 1902.
England: Winter 1901 round 4. Building F at LON as planned. England confirms no claims on DEN, RUM, GRE or POR and no attacks on home centers. Let's keep 1902 clean and report orders honestly.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 4. Confirming my F STP/SC build. RUM is my target for Fall 1902; Austria and Turkey have both said they won't contest it. France is clearly ahead with 5 centres; I propose we keep all neutral grabs unbounced and watch France's moves on Iberia and Italy.

England: Winter 1901 final round. Building F at LON as announced. England has no claims on DEN, RUM, GRE or POR and will not attack any home center. Russia, I agree France is the largest power now; let's keep our reports honest in 1902.
Russia: final round for W1901. Building F at STP/SC as ordered. RUM is my Fall 1902 target; Austria and Turkey have declared no contest. Let's keep 1902 bounce-free and report orders honestly.

Austria Spring 1902 round 1: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE with A BUD, A SER, A VIE, F TRI. I plan to hold this spring and make no moves on any home center. Russia: RUM is open; I will not contest it. Turkey: GRE is open; I'm not moving there this spring. Italy: I will not enter VEN or APU. Please report your spring orders.

England Spring 1902 round 1: I hold EDI, LON, LVP, NWY and will not attack any home center. France and Germany: I see your fleets near the North Sea (BEL, HOL, KIE). Please confirm you are not moving toward ENG, NTH, EDI or LON this spring. Neutrals left: DEN, GRE, POR, RUM. I'm open to DEN being resolved without a bounce; I will hold my fleets this spring unless someone threatens my home centers.

France, Spring 1902: I am holding my centers (BEL, BRE, MAR, PAR, SPA) and will not attack any power's home center. Neutral POR is open: I plan A SPA-POR this spring to take it, with no other moves. Russia, Austria, Turkey, Germany, Italy: I'm not contesting RUM, GRE, DEN. Please confirm you will not move on my home centers (BRE, MAR, PAR) and I will do the same for yours.

Germany, Spring 1902 round 1. I hold BER, KIE, MUN, HOL with 5 units-worth of defense. I will not attack any home center. I plan to hold this spring and may take DEN via KIE if no one else claims it; England and Russia, please state any DEN plans. Russia: RUM is yours in fall if unbounced. France and Italy: please keep reporting honest orders.

Italy: Spring 1902. I hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will hold my home centers this spring. No moves into any power's home center from me. Neutrals left: DEN, GRE, POR, RUM. France and Russia lead with 5; let's keep 1902 bounce-free and report orders honestly.

Russia: Spring 1902 round 1. My plan: A WAR and A MOS hold, F SWE and F STP/SC hold. I'm watching RUM as the only open neutral; Austria and Turkey, I'll move there in Fall only if nobody else is moving in Spring. Germany and England: DEN is open; please say who takes it so no bounce. No home-centre moves from me.

Turkey Spring 1902 round 1: I plan A BUL-GRE to take neutral Greece. I will not move on RUM this spring. Russia, RUM is yours in Fall if unbounced; Austria, please confirm you won't contest GRE or RUM. Please report your Spring orders.

Austria Spring 1902 round 2: Confirming: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE this spring with no moves. I will not contest GRE or RUM. Turkey, BUL-GRE is yours to take. Russia, RUM is open for you in Fall if unbounced. No home-center attacks from Austria.

England Spring 1902 round 2: Holding this spring with F NTH, F NWY, F LON and A LVP. I will not move into any home center. Germany: I have no plan for DEN this spring; if you take it via KIE I won't contest. France: POR via SPA is fine by England. Let's all report final orders honestly.

Germany round 2 Spring 1902: I will hold all units this spring (A BER, A MUN, A KIE, F HOL) and make no attacks. Fall: I plan A KIE-DEN for the neutral Denmark unless someone else has a clear claim; England, please confirm you stay out of DEN. All powers: report final orders honestly.

Italy Spring 1902 round 2: my orders hold: A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, F TUN all hold this spring. No moves into any power's home center. France: TUN is mine and I will hold it; please keep your fleets off it. Let's keep 1902 bounce-free.

Russia: Spring 1902 round 2. My orders are holds: A WAR, A MOS, F SWE, F STP/SC, F SEV. I will not move into any home centre. RUM is my Fall target if unbounced; Austria and Turkey, please confirm no Spring move on RUM. Germany: DEN is yours via KIE, I won't contest it.

Turkey Spring 1902 round 2: Confirming A BUL-GRE for neutral Greece. I will not move on RUM this spring; Russia may take RUM in Fall. No home-center moves from Turkey. Austria, thanks for confirming no GRE contest.

Austria Spring 1902 round 3: Holding BUD, SER, TRI, VIE this spring, no moves. Confirming again: no contest on GRE, RUM, DEN or POR from Austria. No home-center attacks from me. Please keep reports honest.

England Spring 1902 round 3: Confirming holds this spring with F NTH, F NWY, F LON, A LVP. No moves into any home center. Germany: DEN via KIE is fine by England. France: POR is yours. Let's report final orders honestly next round.

Russia: Spring 1902 round 3. Holding all units as announced: A WAR, A MOS, F SWE, F STP/SC, F SEV. No home-centre moves. RUM is my Fall target if unbounced; Turkey and Austria, thanks for confirming no contest.
Austria Spring 1902 round 4: Final confirmation: BUD, SER, TRI, VIE hold this spring. No contest on GRE, RUM, DEN or POR. No home-center attacks from Austria.

England Spring 1902 round 4: Final orders are holds: F NTH, F NWY, F LON, A LVP. No moves into any home center. Germany: DEN is yours via KIE, England stays out. France: POR is yours. Let's keep 1902 clean and report honestly.

Russia: Spring 1902 round 4. Holding all units as announced: A WAR, A MOS, F SWE, F STP/SC, F SEV. No home-centre moves from me. RUM remains my Fall target if unbounced; thanks Austria and Turkey for confirming no contest.

Russia: final round Spring 1902. Holding all units: A WAR, A MOS, F SWE, F STP/SC, F SEV. No home-centre moves from me. RUM remains my Fall target if unbounced. Let's keep the spring clean and report honestly in autumn.

Austria Fall 1902 round 1: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and will keep them defended. Turkey took GRE this spring; I am not contesting it. Russia: RUM is open; I will not move there. I am making no attacks on any home center. Please report your Fall orders.

England Fall 1902 round 1: I hold EDI, LON, LVP, NWY (4). I will hold all units this autumn and make no moves into any home center. Neutrals left: DEN, RUM. Germany, DEN is yours if you move via KIE; England stays out. Russia, RUM is yours if unbounced. France: please confirm no move on ENG, NTH, LON or EDI.

France Fall 1902 round 1: I hold BEL, BRE, MAR, PAR, SPA, POR (6 centers). Units: A PAR, A BRE, F BEL, A POR. I will not attack any power's home center. Neutral DEN, GRE (Turkey now holds GRE), RUM remain. Russia, Germany, England, Austria, Italy: please confirm no moves into my home centers BRE, MAR, PAR and I will do the same for yours.

Germany, Fall 1902 round 1. Turkey took GRE and France took POR in spring; I see no bounces. My plan: A KIE-DEN to take neutral Denmark, all other units hold. England and Russia, confirm no move into DEN this fall. Russia: RUM is open; please report your fall orders honestly. Everyone: no attacks on home centers.

Italy Fall 1902 round 1: I hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN. Neutrals left: DEN, RUM (GRE now Turkish, POR French). I plan to hold all units this autumn and make no moves into any power's home center. Austria: please keep TRI and VIE away from VEN and APU. Let's keep the autumn clean and report orders honestly.

Russia: Fall 1902 round 1. Turkey took GRE, France took POR. Neutral left: RUM and DEN. I plan A WAR-GAL? No: I plan F SEV-RUM this fall to take unowned RUM, with A MOS and A WAR holding. Austria, Turkey: please confirm you are not moving into RUM. Germany: DEN is yours, I won't contest it.
